blocks.text: Devi Ahilya Vishwa Vidyalaya Khandwa Road

rows.text: Title- “Studies on Graph Theoretical Descriptors in Nano-Technology: Carbon Nanotubes”

blocks.text: Worked as a contract lecturer, in the Department of Applied Mathematics and Computational Sc., S.G.S. Institute of Technology and Sciences, Indore, from 31st July 2002 to 23rd Aug. 2007. Taught B.E. and M. Sc. (Applied Maths, Discrete Mathematics, Functional Analysis, Partial Differential Equations and Operations Research.) classes.

Working as an Associate Professor, in the department of Applied Sciences (Mathematics) at IET, DAVV, Indore, since 24th Aug. 2007. Teaching B.Tech. (Applied Math-I, II, III, IV, Discrete Math.) and M. Sc. (Algebra, Real Analysis, Topology, Discrete Mathematics, Operations Research, Complex Analysis and MATLAB) classes.
